title: The Fortress and the Threshold — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of The Fortress and the Threshold's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: Four poles, none of them wrong
pieces.caption: Stoicism, Confucianism, Spinoza Conatus and The Drift at four corners, wearing their own avatars, with a red line wherever the map says one contradicts another. This page sits in the middle holding all four. *What is real and what is a choice:* The four red lines are real 'contradicts' links. 'The striving' and 'no architecture' are my paraphrases of the page. *Leaking in:* Stoicism, Confucianism, Spinoza Conatus, The Drift.
